Version =21
VersionRequired =20
Begin Form
    Width =7200
    RecordSource ="SELECT tblTrays.TrayKey, tblTrays.Bench, tblTrays.Sown FROM tblTrays ORDER BY tblTrays.Bench"
    Caption ="Tray bench overview"
    OnOpen ="[Event Procedure]"
    Begin
        Begin Section
            Height =3600
            Name ="Detail"
            Begin
                Begin TextBox
                    Left =1440
                    Top =360
                    Width =3600
                    Height =300
                    Name ="txtYield"
                    ControlSource ="=TrayYieldScore([Sprouted],[Sown]) & \" percent of seeds came up\""
                End
            End
        End
    End
End
CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Option Compare Database

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
    If DCount("*", "tblTrays", "Wilted = True") > 25 Then
        MsgBox "More than two dozen wilted trays: check the misting schedule first", vbExclamation
    End If
End Sub
